300.name: Light
300.usage: Hero headings, section titles over splash images — 28px and above only

400.name: Regular
400.usage: Logotype / header — preserves thin character at smaller sizes

500.name: Medium
500.usage: h2, h3, lesson card names, buttons — readability over elegance

600.name: SemiBold
600.usage: Emphasis only — prices, CTA buttons, statistics

notes.palette: Warm off-white background (#fcfaf8) with dusty rose / terracotta accents. Berry (#a9436b) as brand accent. Mint (#51d3a7) and yellow (#ffd47d) as complementary pops.
notes.typography: Raleway for all headings (elegant, thin), Manrope for all body and UI text (clean, readable). No Poppins in production — it appeared in the style guide annotation only.
notes.logoColor: Logo uses the red-coral range (#e86667 → #e44443) with dark plum (#402b32) as contrast.
